[SWS_CM_10450] InstanceSpecifier check during the creation of service skeleton
⌈
The Communication Management shall check the value of the In-
stanceSpecifier argument: the specifier shall be unique, using the same instance
specifier for the creation of more than one skeleton instance of the same service shall
be handled according to [SWS_CORE_00001].
⌋
